subject.title: feat: validate required run artifacts against a schema (`--require-artifact-schema`)

question: Should Crabbox permanently expose this bespoke fail-closed JSON Schema subset as a public CLI contract, or require a narrower or standards-compatible validation approach?
rationale: Correctness hardening cannot decide whether Crabbox should own and evolve a nonstandard schema language; that choice affects future CLI compatibility and maintenance scope.

options.title: Use a maintained validator
options.body: Keep the feature but replace the bespoke language with a maintained standards-compatible implementation and explicitly document the supported draft and resource limits.

options.title: Retain the Crabbox subset
options.body: Approve the current narrow fail-closed language as a Crabbox-specific stable contract and commit to its compatibility and evolution.

options.title: Keep validation repo-owned
options.body: Decline the new flag and continue requiring each repository command to validate its own evidence before Crabbox checks or collects the artifact.

recommendation.title: Use a maintained validator
recommendation.body: Keep the feature but replace the bespoke language with a maintained standards-compatible implementation and explicitly document the supported draft and resource limits.

likelyOwner.reason: He performed the current-head hardening pass and explicitly identified this unresolved contract decision.
